bastion_cinder_ford.title: Cinder Ford
bastion_cinder_ford.summary: Aegis takes the river guns to stop a Helix convoy. Voss follows a civilian signal through the barrage.
bastion_cinder_ford.summary_zh: 埃吉斯夺取河岸炮阵，阻止螺旋车队。沃斯在炮火中追踪平民的求救信号。

objectives.title: Secure the western fire-control post
Disable the convoy command vehicle
Hold the ford while Voss searches the wrecks
objectives.zh_CN: 守住渡口，掩护沃斯搜索残骸

objectives.title: Bring the survivors to the aid station
objectives.zh_CN: 护送幸存者前往救护站

helix_quiet_streets.title: Quiet Streets
helix_quiet_streets.summary: Nyx restores power to a sealed district. A detained family makes order look less like mercy.
helix_quiet_streets.summary_zh: 尼克斯恢复封锁街区的供电。一个被扣押的家庭让“秩序”不再像仁慈。

objectives.title: Reconnect the clinic substation
Escort the detained families to the clinic
objectives.zh_CN: 护送被扣押的家庭前往诊所

objectives.title: Protect the clinic until its power stabilizes
objectives.zh_CN: 保护诊所，等待供电稳定

helix_the_gate.title: The Gate
helix_the_gate.summary: The night Meridian closed. Nyx must keep two gate controls online while Elias calls from the other side.
helix_the_gate.summary_zh: 子午城封锁之夜。尼克斯必须维持两座城门控制站，而伊莱亚斯正在门外呼救。

objectives.title: Restore the outer gate controls
Keep the evacuation channel open
Reach the inner gate before CANTOR seals it
objectives.zh_CN: 赶在坎托封门前抵达内门

helix_cinder_ford.title: Cinder Ford
helix_cinder_ford.summary: The crossing is under Bastion fire. Nyx turns the convoy toward civilians CANTOR has written off.
helix_cinder_ford.summary_zh: 渡口遭到堡垒炮击。尼克斯把车队引向那些被坎托放弃的平民。

objectives.title: Silence the north-bank artillery
Guide the relief convoy across the ford
objectives.zh_CN: 引导救援车队穿过渡口

objectives.title: Cover the last vehicles at the eastern ramp
objectives.zh_CN: 在东岸坡道掩护最后的车辆

helix_pruning.title: Pruning
helix_pruning.summary: Ilan lives in a district marked for erasure. Nyx breaks the command chain to find him.
helix_pruning.summary_zh: 伊兰所在街区被列入清除名单。尼克斯违抗指挥系统，去找自己的儿子。

objectives.title: Destroy the district isolation node
Locate Ilan through the school terminal
Bring Ilan and the children to the tunnels
objectives.zh_CN: 护送伊兰和孩子们进入隧道

helix_severance.title: Severance
helix_severance.summary: Arden holds the Meridian Spire. Ren must decide whether loyalty means obeying or staying beside Nyx.
helix_severance.summary_zh: 阿登控制着子午尖塔。任必须决定，忠诚是服从命令，还是留在尼克斯身边。

objectives.title: Cut Arden off from the outer defense grid
objectives.zh_CN: 切断阿登与外围防御网的连接

objectives.title: Breach the command shield generator
Destroy CANTOR's command core

frontier_drainage.title: Drainage
frontier_drainage.summary: Rook and Wren lead the last families below Meridian. The safe route is the one they build together.
frontier_drainage.summary_zh: 鲁克和雷恩带领最后的家庭潜入子午城地下。他们必须亲手开辟安全通道。

objectives.title: Open the drainage sluice
Guide the refugees through the service trench
Hold the tunnel mouth for the stragglers
objectives.zh_CN: 守住隧道口，等待掉队者

frontier_cinder_ford.title: Cinder Ford
frontier_cinder_ford.summary: Wren's caravan is caught beneath the guns. Rook has to choose a route through the smoke.
frontier_cinder_ford.summary_zh: 雷恩的车队陷入炮火。鲁克必须在浓烟中找到一条生路。

objectives.title: Break the southern roadblock
Get Wren's caravan beyond the river guns
objectives.zh_CN: 护送雷恩的车队逃离河岸炮火

objectives.title: Search the abandoned ambulance station

frontier_salvage.title: Salvage
frontier_salvage.summary: Jory wants a raid. Rook wants medicine. The depot has both, and a commander who will remember the choice.
frontier_salvage.summary_zh: 乔里想要复仇，鲁克想要药品。仓库里两者都有，还有一个会记住这次选择的指挥官。

objectives.title: Take the depot inventory office
Disable the armored depot guard
Deliver the medical stores to Hask
objectives.zh_CN: 把医疗物资送到哈斯克手中

frontier_wren.title: Wren
frontier_wren.summary: A Bastion transmission names the work camp. Rook accepts help from the army he cannot forgive.
frontier_wren.summary_zh: 堡垒的通话透露了劳役营的位置。鲁克接受了那个他无法原谅的军队的帮助。

objectives.title: Shut down the camp perimeter grid
Find Wren in the workshop block
Escort Wren and the prisoners to extraction
objectives.zh_CN: 护送雷恩和囚犯前往撤离点

frontier_the_coalition.title: The Coalition
frontier_the_coalition.summary: Hask offers a coalition. Jory wants a war. At the Spire, Rook decides what surviving was for.
frontier_the_coalition.summary_zh: 哈斯克主张结盟，乔里渴望战争。在尖塔下，鲁克必须决定他们为何而活。

objectives.title: Unite the coalition at the relay square
Protect the joint relief corridor
Break the Spire command garrison
